activation_condition: Activate only if the preregistered rootedstock_delay16v4 fresh screen has one or more demonstrably non-equivalent pairs.

motivation.structural_fact: The synthetic model is a hybrid event system: force movement advances every 0.25 day and command decisions recur every 1.0 day by default.
motivation.hypothesis: If first-order committed mass plus mean ETA is insufficient, closure may require the distribution of committed force across event-clock phases. Two pipelines with equal mass and mean ETA can still cross different movement/command boundaries and therefore generate different futures.
motivation.falsifier: If event-clock-aligned pipeline bins also leave demonstrably non-equivalent pairs on a fresh block, local movement phase structure is not sufficient closure.

bin_rationale.0_to_0.25_days: resolves before or at the next force-movement tick
bin_rationale.0.25_to_1_days: resolves within the current command cycle
bin_rationale.over_1_day: persists across at least one new command opportunity

fresh_screen.nomination_rule: Zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs required. Sixteen branches cannot certify closure.

fresh_confirmation.activation: Only if fresh_screen has zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs.

stop_rule: If phase18 fails, stop local movement-coordinate accretion. The next theory class must represent nonlocal source/composition or an explicitly non-Markov renewal kernel, not additional ad hoc local scalars.
scientific_guard: This is a synthetic structural test. A PASS would support event-phase-aware reduced closure on the tested synthetic support, not historical universality.
